name: ScanEvent
description: DACO-20260613-MOBILE-SCANNER — Append-only scan participation log. Records every QR scan, ID barcode read, and camera capture event from mobile or fixed scanners. Quarantine-aware: validation_run flag isolates funds-off training runs from live events.

subject_id.description: ID of the entity scanned (driver_id, guest_id, id_number).

venue_id.description: Venue where scan occurred. Dynamic — never hardcoded.

scan_type.description: QR code, ID barcode (PDF417), camera capture, or manual entry.

scanned_by.description: Email of staff member who performed the scan.

scanned_by_role.description: Role of scanner (DOOR_GIRL, DOORMAN, SECURITY, etc.).

validation_run.description: DACO-20260613-DOOR-RBAC — true = funds-off training run. Quarantined from booked reports.

funds_settled.description: false when validation_run=true. Excludes record from settlement rollups.

details.description: JSON-encoded scan metadata (e.g., age_verified, name_match, barcode_data).
